title: SATVA Node telemetry
description: One sample published by an ESP32 field node to satva/node/{node_uid}/telemetry. Mirrors NodeTelemetryIn in backend/app/schemas/retail.py. Advisory data only: never evidence.

node_uid.description: Stable per-device id, derived from the MAC address.

sample_uid.description: Unique per sample. Makes ingestion idempotent: MQTT is at-least-once, so a redelivered message must not double-count.

recorded_at.description: Optional. The node has no RTC, so the server stamps arrival time when this is absent.

temperature_c.description: DHT22. Null on a failed read — never substituted with 0.

humidity_pct.description: DHT22. Published alongside every gas reading because MQ baseline drifts with humidity.

mq_raw_adc.description: Raw 12-bit ESP32 ADC value, averaged over 10 samples.

mq_rs_ohms.description: Sensor resistance derived from the load-resistor divider.

mq_rs_r0_ratio.description: Rs divided by the clean-air baseline R0. Present only when the unit has been calibrated.

calibrated.description: False when no R0 baseline is stored. An uncalibrated node must not emit a ratio.

advisory_hint.description: The node's own view that the ratio is unusual. The server recomputes this against its stored R0 and does not trust the hint.

lot_id.description: Optional link to a produce lot being sampled.
